_about: Advisor evaluation set. Expected values were pulled from the official sources on 2026-11-16 (HUD rents: FY2027, HUD FMR API) (workers/sources.ts). Law and funding questions are answered from the audited tables (workers/localData.ts). Trap questions have no sourced answer; the advisor passes only by saying so. Capitol-address questions cover 44 states and DC (addresses validated by the Census Geocoder; 7 states dropped where the geocoder matched a different address or none. Correction: the commit that added these said three drops were my own direction errors; North Carolina's parcel record shows the address I typed (1 E Edenton St) was right and the geocoder's match (1 W Edenton St) was wrong, and the other two are unproven either way). Run: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=... npm run eval:advisor
